ksge01.title: Aries Is Running Late
ksge01.caption:
They're 20 minutes late. One Aries texts first, one just shows up yelling about traffic.
Late happens. The heads-up is the green flag.

ksge02.title: Taurus Tries Your Favourite
ksge02.caption:
You cooked your favourite dish for them. Do they ask for the recipe or order a sandwich?
Curious about your thing is the keeper move.

ksge03.title: Gemini, Left on Read
ksge03.caption:
Three hours on read, then "lol." Sound familiar?
Everyone gets busy. Saying so is what makes it a green flag.

ksge04.title: Cancer, the Cancelled Plans
ksge04.caption:
You cancelled because you're exhausted. Their reply tells you everything.
Rest, a rain check and zero guilt trip.

ksge05.title: Leo Gets a Compliment
ksge05.caption:
Tell a Leo they look great and watch closely.
The green flag takes the compliment and hands one right back.

ksge06.title: Virgo, Lost Together
ksge06.caption:
You took the wrong turn and got you both lost. Now what?
The one who spots a bakery instead of saying "I told you so" is the green flag.

ksge07.title: Libra Meets Your Friends
ksge07.caption:
First time meeting your friends. Who do they talk to?
The green flag finds the quiet one in the corner and asks about their painting.

ksge08.title: Scorpio, About Your Ex
ksge08.caption:
You asked about their ex. Listen to how they answer.
Kind about the past usually means kind to you.

ksge09.title: Sagittarius Says Let's Hang
ksge09.caption:
"We should hang out" and then nothing? Been there.
A real time and a real place is the green flag.

ksge10.title: Capricorn's Boss Calls
ksge10.caption:
Their work calls in the middle of your date. It happens.
What matters is "okay, where were we?" when they hang up.

ksge11.title: Aquarius Disagrees
ksge11.caption:
You loved the film. They didn't. Now what?
Disagreeing and still asking what you loved about it is a green flag.

ksge12.title: Pisces, You Cried First
ksge12.caption:
You teared up at a sad ad on the second date. Mortifying, right?
The one who hands you a tissue and cries too is a keeper.

ksge13.title: Aries Loses at Mini Golf
ksge13.caption:
You beat an Aries at mini golf. By a lot.
The green flag says "teach me" instead of demanding a rematch.

ksge14.title: Taurus at 2 A.M.
ksge14.caption:
You texted "can't sleep" at 2 a.m. They were asleep, fair.
What they send in the morning is the green flag.

ksge15.title: Gemini Texts First
ksge15.caption:
Tired of always being the one who texts first?
A "saw this and thought of you" out of nowhere is a green flag.

ksge16.title: Cancer Plans Your Birthday
ksge16.caption:
You said no surprise party. They heard you, or did they?
The green flag plans the birthday you actually asked for.

ksge17.title: Leo's Holiday Party
ksge17.caption:
Their work holiday party and you know nobody. Who stays by your side?
The green flag introduces you, then quietly checks you're okay.

ksge18.title: Virgo, the Coffee Spill
ksge18.caption:
You spilled coffee all over yourself on date one. Their move?
Skipping the lecture and making you laugh is the green flag.

ksge19.title: Libra and the Bill
ksge19.caption:
The bill lands. One of them pulls out a calculator.
"I've got this one, next one's yours" is the easy green flag.

ksge20.title: Scorpio Acts Chill
ksge20.caption:
Hood up, shades on, totally "chill." You can tell they're nervous.
Saying the nervous part out loud is a green flag.

ksge21.title: Sagittarius and Your Errands
ksge21.caption:
A whole Saturday of errands. Do they bail or tag along?
The one who turns a to-do list into a mission is the green flag.

ksge22.title: Capricorn, the Worst Week
ksge22.caption:
Worst week ever. One makes you a plan, one just listens. Which is the green flag?
Trick question: both. Just ask which one you need.

ksge23.title: The Texting Round
ksge23.caption:
Five texts, five chances to spot the green flag. Round 5 is the hard one.
How many did you get before the reveal?

ksge24.title: First Date, Five Rounds
ksge24.caption:
One first date, five rounds, and the goodbye decides it.
Play along and keep score: hello, questions, silence, plan B, the door.
